notes: The two assigned rows supply identical study/outcome descriptions and the same broad p. 5 locator, without identifying an interaction or a simple comparison. The probability-estimate outcome has two relevant printed tests: Anchor × Time Pressure interaction F(1,58) = 5.06, p < .05 on printed p. 384 (PDF p. 5), and high-versus-low Anchor under Time Pressure t(28) = 2.37, p < .05 on printed p. 385 (PDF p. 6). The description emphasizes time pressure but does not explicitly distinguish these tests. Row correspondence cannot be established independently; no assignment by row order or numeric matching was made. Candidates retained as printed test statistics, without metric conversion: F = 5.06 and t = 2.37; each has its own printed p < .05 (bound l). The response-latency manipulation check F(1,58) = 8.56, p < .01 concerns another outcome and is excluded. The no-Time-Pressure comparison t(30) < 1, ns is outside the described time-pressure condition. Rendered PDF pp. 5–6 inspected for layout; canonical text uses D for the printed equals sign. N, replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders; no analytic N was inferred.
